# Sirach Chapter 51 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 51 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/SIR_051_page_001.jpg

---

51:1 I will give thanks to you, O Lord, O King, and I will praise you, the God my Savior; I give thanks to your name,

51:2 for you were a protector and helper to me, and redeemed my body from destruction and from the trap of a slanderous tongue, from lips that utter falsehood; and against those who stand against me you were a helper,

51:3 and you saved me according to the abundance of your mercy and your name's sake, from grinding teeth about to devour me, from the hand of those who seek my life, from the many afflictions that came upon me,

51:4 from the choking fire on every side and from the midst of fire, which I did not kindle,

51:5 from the depth of the belly of Hades, from an unclean tongue and from false words —

51:6 a false tale to the king by a wicked tongue. My soul drew near to death, and my life was near to the depths of Hades.

51:7 They surrounded me on every side and there was no one to help me; I looked for the help of men, and there was none.

51:8 Then I remembered your mercy, O Lord, and your work from everlasting; for you deliver those who wait on you and save them from the hand of enemies.

51:9 And I lifted up my supplication from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.

51:10 I called upon the Lord, the father of my lord: "Do not forsake me in the days of trouble, in the time of the proud, when there is no help.

51:11 I will praise your name continually and will sing praises with thanksgiving." And my prayer was heard,

51:12 for you saved me from destruction and delivered me from the evil time. Therefore I will give thanks and praise to you, and bless the name of the Lord.

51:13 When I was young, before I went on my travels, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.

51:14 Before the temple I asked for her, and I will search for her to the last.

51:15 From the blossoming of fruit until it was ripe, my heart delighted in her; my foot walked on the straight path; from my youth I have tracked her.

51:16 I inclined my ear a little, and I received her and found much instruction for myself.

51:17 I made progress in her; to him who gives wisdom I will give glory.

51:18 For I purposed to live by her, and I was zealous for the good and I will not be put to shame.

51:19 My soul wrestled for her, and in my doing I was confirmed. I stretched out my hands to the heights, and I mourned my ignorance of her.

51:20 I directed my soul to her, and in purity I found her; I gained a heart together with her from the beginning; therefore I will not be forsaken.

51:21 My inward being was stirred to seek her; therefore I have gained a good possession.

51:22 The Lord gave to me a tongue as my reward, and I will praise him with it.

51:23 Draw near to me, you who are uneducated, and lodge in the house of instruction.

51:24 Why do you say you lack these things and yet your souls are very thirsty?

51:25 I opened my mouth and said: "Buy for yourselves without money.

51:26 Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction; she is close to find.

51:27 See with your eyes that I labored but little, and I found for myself much rest.

51:28 Acquire teaching at the cost of much silver, and by means of it gain much gold.

51:29 May your soul rejoice in his mercy, and may you not be put to shame in his praise.

51:30 Do your work before the appointed time, and he will give your reward in his time."
